# glinet_system_timezone (Data Source)

Get the time zone configuration of the router (`system.get_timezone_config`). To change it, use `glinet_system_timezone`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glinet_system_timezone" "router" {}

output "router_timezone" {
  value = data.glinet_system_timezone.router.zone_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `auto_timezone_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the router sets the time zone automatically (`autotimezone_enabled`).
- `localtime` (Number) Current time of the router, as a Unix time in seconds.
- `timestamp` (Number) Clock of the router, as a Unix time in seconds.
- `timezone` (String) POSIX TZ string, for example `CET-1CEST,M3.5.0,M10.5.0/3`.
- `timezone_offset` (String) Current offset from UTC, for example `+0100`. It changes with daylight saving time.
- `zone_name` (String) Time zone name as the router shows it, for example `Europe/Berlin`. Empty when the router gives none.
